summary: Most of the work is accurate and readable. The status cards for UM21, GT21, GT23, GT24, GT25, Gait120 and MBLUE match their cited audits, and the GT21 '102 of 2,301, stopped' claim is exact. The four count mismatches are real. The GT23 unit correction matches GT23-C02 and its erratum, and the GT24 sentence and errata are untouched. The JS changes keep name parsing and previews working, the pages read clearly at true 390 px and 1100 px, and all gates pass. Two claims overstate the evidence and must be fixed. First, the StrokePiG card and label present two native source-channel exports as rebuilt pilot recordings, and they omit an earlier 46-recording run. Second, converted_datasets/README.md calls every reconversion_v2 job directory 'rebuilt, source-checked'.

evidence.sp50_source_checked_pilot: FAILED. strokepig-source-coverage.json native_companion_pilots: two 'exact_source_companion_readback' records. Their row counts (504 and 168) are not multiples of 150, and their checks are 'components_and_residuals'. They are native source-channel time-series exports, which is SP50-F01's 'preserve native sources' step; no phase cycles were reconstructed. The card's 'Rebuilt: 2 of 151 walking recordings' and the catalog label 'Source-checked pilot' (defined as 'a few recordings rebuilt and matched to the original files') put them in the same tier as the GT24 canonical-observation pilots. The card also omits PM-02 row strokepig_serial_20261020: completed 46/46 recordings, 136 observations (20,400 rows), completed_unreviewed, with no source check recorded. Its 'A full export is prepared but stopped' is correct (native_after_fukuchi stopped_incomplete; native_full never launched).

Add the earlier 20 Oct run of 46 recordings / 136 observations, which is unreviewed with no source check recorded (PM-02 strokepig_serial_20261020). Then make the catalog label and card label consistent with the definition. Either use 'Legacy only' and note the native-export pilot in the card, or revise the label definition so that 'Source-checked pilot' does not imply rebuilt LocoHub cycles. Update the catalog row on both docs/index.html and docs/datasets/index.html together.

F2 (converted_datasets/README.md): Replace the 'Rebuilt, source-checked (partial)' row. reconversion_v2/ holds job directories of many kinds: rebuilt outputs, source-check receipts, plans, censuses, and stopped or superseded runs. Only outputs whose job has a completed source-readback receipt are source-checked, for that receipt's scope. Point readers to the Status by dataset section and the PM-02 dispositions rather than implying every job directory qualifies.
